name: Delina, Wild Mage — "except it's not legendary" describes the token
notes: Sweep singleton (2026-10-07). Found while probing the d20 cards: the token description "a copy of that creature, except it's not legendary" was read as "every permanent is not legendary" (about 25 token-copy cards did this, statically or when fired). Isamaru stays legendary, with Delina on the battlefield and with the 1—14 result fired.
